contexts.text: The Lord requires from man thanksgivings, etc. but not for His own sake. Explained.
A continual thanksgiving for deliverance from condemnation. Signified, Explained.
The three feasts = thanksgiving because of regeneration.
The feast of unleavened things = worship and thanksgiving for purification from falsities. ( = thanksgiving for deliverance from evil and the falsities of evil. AC 10655.)
My faces shall not be seen emptily = the reception of good from mercy, and thanksgiving.
The feast of harvest = ... thanksgiving for the implantation of truth in good.
Confession and thanksgiving from a good heart. Signified.
The Angels therefore refuse all thanksgiving for the good they do.

When the animals gave glory, and honour, and thanksgiving () = that the Word ascribes all truth, good, and worship to the Lord... Thanksgiving = all worship. ( = Glorification. AE 288.) ( = the Lord's Divine Spiritual. AR 372.)
Thanksgiving is said of Divine truth; for man gives thanks from and through it.
We give Thee thanks. Lord God Almighty ()... To give thanks = the acknowledgement and Glorification of the Lord.
Thanksgiving, confession, and celebration of the Lord by the Angels of the lower Heavens. Signified, Explained. AR 807. AR 808.
After giving thanks they went home.
The Lord does not demand any thanksgiving... and if a Spirit purposes to give thanks, he can by no means do so except from manifest permission.
Thanksgiving that from the Lord is all good and truth... Signified, Explained.
Thanksgiving and honour () = that this is from the Divine good which proceeds from the Lord in the three Heavens... Thanksgiving and honour are predicated of the reception of Divine good.
For thanksgiving is made in the heart from good.
